title: aVolClusterPOI OFF_PRICE — formal first-passage race from canonical ticks

p2_gate.scope: 6E_09-26 ticks in [2026-04-10, 2026-06-30] (NT8 oracle window; warmup starts empty at window start, like NT8)
p2_gate.oracle: 133 ZONE_CREATED rows of the NT8 v0.5 CSV
p2_gate.match_rule: per-row match on (lower_tick, upper_tick) exact and bar_close_time within +/-1 minute
p2_gate.pass_rule: 100% oracle rows matched AND zero unmatched Python zones in window; otherwise FAIL with the full diff list
p2_gate.ordering: P2_PASS is required before the formal race; a FAIL closes the run as ABSTAIN_P2

race.population: all OFF_PRICE ZONE_CREATED from the Python kernel over the 4 research parquets, chronological, warmup handled by the kernel itself
race.mirror: m_lo = 2*anchor - hi, m_hi = 2*anchor - lo (exact integer reflection)
race.machinery: F2.7 first_passage_race + zone_lifecycle + tick_first_touch; construir_reflejo for the mirrored lifecycle (D2 symmetry)
race.lifecycle: CloseThrough, max_age 0, identical on both arms
race.r_i: +1 zone first, -1 mirror first, 0 otherwise; zeros ENTER the session mean
race.ties: resolved by tick_first_touch; tie rate is reported, not gated (ticks resolve)
race.aggregation: session-equal mean, HAC Bartlett lag=ceil(sqrt(n_sessions)), CI95

controls.primary: control_random (same session, uniform among eligible bars, >12 bars from any creator, deterministic seed (session, bar))
controls.diagnostic_only: control_nearest (same rules, nearest eligible bar); NOT citable as evidence
controls.placement: same (d, w, side) as the zone, anchored at the control bar close

declared_before_run: control_random is the primary benchmark (declared in the v2.1 output audit, before any tick result)
